name: Damage numbers
author: LucienTo
description: Shows how much damage each hit does, from the wrench, a weapon or a bomb: a number pops up where the hit landed, tilts and flies off in its own direction, and fades out. Hits close together on the same enemy add up into one number: yellow, orange once it adds up, red for the hit that kills.

settings.name: Duration
settings.description: How long a number flies and fades before it is gone, in seconds.

settings.name: Style
settings.description: In the world: each number drawn as outlined digits in the level, facing the camera, with room for every hit. HUD text: the game's own font, at most 16 lines shared by all mods.

settings.name: HUD text outline
settings.description: HUD text only: a dark outline round each number. It takes 3 of the 16 HUD lines mods share, so at most 5 numbers show at once.

settings.name: HUD text numbers at once
settings.description: HUD text only: the most numbers shown at once (at most 5 with the outline); the oldest goes first.

settings.name: Enemies only
settings.description: Only enemies and people, not crates or other objects.
